trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read. Three negations ('It does not use real-number arithmetic', 'It does not depend on whether Vol(K) is transcendental, algebraic, or irrational', 'No result requires this conjecture') - all substantive, because independence from the conjecture IS the block's content (it interprets conj:hyperbolic-volume-transcendence and its whole job is to scope that conjecture out of the derivation chain).

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: No setup-then-reframe; the paragraphs are declarative scope statements.

trap-em-dash.evidence: No spaced em-dashes; the only '--' is the LaTeX en-dash in the proper name Groebner--Shirshov.

trap-triples.evidence: 'It does not depend on whether $\mathrm{Vol}(K)$ is transcendental, algebraic, or irrational.' - a three-item list whose items are not alternatives: 'algebraic' and 'irrational' overlap (sqrt(2) is both) and 'transcendental' entails 'irrational', so the three do not partition anything. The genuine trichotomy is rational / irrational-algebraic / transcendental, and the sentence needs only two of the terms to say what it means. The list was padded to three at the cost of being logically ill-formed.
trap-triples.notes: Structural (a correctness fix, not a register fix), not edited. Proposed fix: 'It does not depend on whether $\mathrm{Vol}(K)$ is algebraic or transcendental.' - two mutually exclusive, jointly exhaustive alternatives, which is exactly the claim intended. A separate four-item substantive list in the same block (Hecke algebra, Skein relations, Groebner--Shirshov normal forms, transfer matrices) is genuine and passes.

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: Ends on the conjecture's technical content ('the specialisation map iota is injective on the extended ring ...'), not a quotable closer.

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: no meta-commentary on the block's own rhetoric
